name: KaoyaSwap
rootCause: Kaoyaswap on BSC appears to have been attacked, with hackers making 37,294 BUSD and 271.2 WBNB, caused by faulty logic in the Swap function.

descriptions.text: Kaoyaswap on BSC appears to have been attacked, with hackers making 37,294 BUSD and 271.2 WBNB, caused by faulty logic in the Swap function.
BSC DEX protocol Kaoyaswap was attacked, losing 37,294 BUSD and 271.2 WBNB. The reason for this attack is the Swap value flaw.

KaoyaSwap was exploited on BNB Chain on 24 August 2022, resulting in losses of approximately $118,000. The attack used a swap logic flaw involving repeated pairs in the swap path, allowing the attacker to drain the protocol via flash loan preparation and mispriced swap payouts. A flaw in the swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens function miscalculated output values when the same pair appeared multiple times in the swap path, allowing repeated withdrawal of value for a single input.
